title: Data Engineer
description:
**Data Engineer** 




**Kochi, India \| Full\-time** 




  





**About PriceSenz:** 




 PriceSenz is an AI\-first technology and digital services company building practical products, automation workflows, and client solutions that solve real business problems. Our work spans internal products such as School Path, Talentz, ADA\-related initiatives, and client\-focused solutions where data plays a key role.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Data Engineer** 
 who can build and maintain scalable data workflows and create a strong data foundation across PriceSenz products and client initiatives.
 



  





 This is a highly execution\-focused role for someone who can work across the end\-to\-end data lifecycle — from identifying and ingesting data from multiple sources to cleaning, transforming, modeling, and operationalizing it for downstream use.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with messy datasets, improving data quality, creating repeatable workflows, and collaborating with engineering and product teams to build reliable and maintainable systems.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Build and maintain end\-to\-end data workflows across multiple sources
* Design and improve data models and data structures
* Perform data ingestion, transformation, normalization, and enrichment
* Create matching and deduplication logic for data quality improvement
* Implement validation and quality checks
* Build processes for refresh schedules, exception handling, and data governance
* Support data integration and operational workflows across internal products and client projects
* Work with engineering and product teams to operationalize and maintain data systems
* Document data workflows, assumptions, and business rules



  





**Core Qualifications:** 



* 2\-6 years of experience in Data Engineering or related hands\-on data roles
* Strong Python experience
* Strong SQL experience
* Experience handling multi\-source datasets
* Experience with data modeling and normalization
* Experience with data quality, matching, and deduplication
* Strong problem\-solving and ownership mindset
* Ability to work in fast\-moving environments



  





**Preferred:** 



* Experience with cloud data platforms
* Experience with BI tools
* Experience with workflow automation
* Experience in startup or product environments



  





***PriceSenz is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability***

title: Product Master Data Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 The Purple Patch Technologies is an expert outsourcing company headquartered in Dubai, UAE, delivering high\-quality services to global clients. With state\-of\-the\-art call center facilities in India and Egypt, the company leverages a diverse, multi\-cultural workforce prepared to handle projects of varying scale and complexity. Its clientele spans multiple industries, including automobile, telecom, customer care, e\-commerce, back office, AI/ML, and subtitling. The company has strong expertise in sales outsourcing and in\-house lead generation, consistently aiming to improve results for every project undertaken.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Product Master Data Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kochi.
 **Dutco Tennant LLC** 
 is looking for an experienced and detail\-oriented
 **Product Master Data Specialist** 
 to join our team in Cochin. Dutco Tennant has over four decades of experience as a distribution partner for engineering and industrial solutions across construction, water, energy, infrastructure, and networking sectors in the Middle East and GCC.
 


 🔹 About the Role
 
 The Product Master Data Specialist will be responsible for
 **product master data governance, SKU/item creation, product classification, and Bill of Materials (BOM) management within Microsoft Dynamics 365** 
 .
 



 The role will ensure that quotations and sales orders use accurate and approved inventory SKUs while maintaining high standards of data quality and preventing duplicate or obsolete product records.
 


 🔹 Key Responsibilities
 * Own and manage the
 **Product Master Data Governance** 
 process.
* Create and maintain item masters, product attributes, categories, dimensions, and units of measure in
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365** 
 .
* Review and approve new SKU requests while preventing duplicate item creation.
* Create and maintain
 **Sales BOMs, Kit BOMs, and other BOM structures** 
 .
* Translate customer requirements into structured SKUs and BOMs.
* Establish and maintain product naming and classification standards.
* Maintain
 **HS/Customs codes, Country of Origin, manufacturer references, and technical attributes** 
 .
* Work closely with
 **Sales, Procurement, Warehouse, Engineering, Finance, and IT** 
 teams.
* Support SKU rationalization and archive obsolete items.
* Develop master data policies, workflows, and approval processes.
* Monitor data\-quality KPIs and prepare dashboards.
* Train internal users on product master data processes and ensure compliance.


 🔹 Requirements
 * Bachelor's degree in
 **Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Information Systems** 
 , or a related discipline.
* **5–8\+ years of experience** 
 in product master data, ERP, industrial distribution, manufacturing, or supply chain.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations (D365 F\&O)** 
 is preferred.
* Strong understanding of
 **BOMs, inventory management, product structures, and ERP master data** 
 .
* Advanced
 **Microsoft Excel** 
 skills.
* **Power BI** 
 experience is desirable.
* Knowledge of industrial products such as
 **PVF, HVAC, MEP, Water Treatment** 
 , or similar products is preferred.
